pages.title: What a respec does
text: A respec refunds every point invested across the 26 lines; your level, total experience and earned points stay exactly the same. It is free and has no cooldown by default.
Because available points are derived (level minus invested points), the refund is instant and exact - there is no refund arithmetic that could drift.

pages.title: Three ways to respec
text: The "Respec (free)" button at the bottom of the point-buy screen.
Right-clicking a Respec Token (rpgleveling:respec_token); see the Items category.

pages.title: Things to know
text: Attributes are recomputed and synced immediately. If your maximum health drops, vanilla clamps your current health to the new maximum, so no free healing is handed out.
A Respec Token is not consumed when nothing is invested, so a misclick cannot waste a stack.
Respecs are counted; see respec_count in /rpg stats.
